argv: ()=>{const o=window.__api6Observer;if(!o)throw new Error('observer absent');for(const method of ['text','json']){const original=Response.prototype[method];Response.prototype[method]=async function(...args){const value=await original.apply(this,args);if(this.url.includes('/graphql'))o.events.push({at:Date.now(),kind:'consumed_http_response',url:this.url,status:this.status,method,body:typeof value==='string'?value:JSON.stringify(value)});return value;};}return{installed:true,note:'observes the Response consumed by existing captured fetch, no payload changes'};}
